note: The MABAYANI artwork and the author's portrait. Source of truth: Google Drive / Masinloc Website Asset / Founder Masinloc, and the portrait supplied directly by the project. The designs and the wordmark are finished artwork; the portrait is a photograph of a living person, supplied by her for this use. None of it is generated here. scripts/build-mabayani-assets.py derives the responsive sizes; scripts/check-photography.py refuses to serve anything under assets/mabayani/ that is not listed below.
rules: Never redesign the artwork, and never alter the wordmark, its colour or its proportions.
Never crop. Each design carries its own copy and composition, and the whole frame stays visible at every width.
The wordmark keeps its transparency. It sits on the page background rather than in a white box, so it is derived as WebP and PNG only — a JPEG would fill the letters' surroundings with white.
No portrait variant is ever fabricated. A second crop is used only if the project supplies one.

The portrait is of a real, living person who supplied it for this page. It is resized and re-encoded and nothing else: not retouched, not recoloured, not cropped to a different framing, and never used anywhere but as her author portrait.

artwork.alt: A quotation card reading: To be MABAYANI now is to protect the town from a different kind of invasion — forgetting, misinformation, contempt, indifference, and the belief that somebody else will do the work. The question is no longer whether Masinloc has brave ancestors. The question is whether Masinloc still has brave descendants. MABAYANI is not finished when it is printed. It begins when a reader decides to become worthy of the history. Signed FMB2026
